name: Design an idempotent data import
short_description: Design an idempotent data import once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can design an idempotent data import in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Design an idempotent data import means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Design an idempotent data import in a fresh real-life scenario.
